'''Jewal Trylo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chief Communication Officer]] of the [[Balmorran resistance]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] motorpool in the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3643 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Trylo appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
